from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from unittest.mock import patch
import json
import sys

from eval.phase05 import verify_frozen as replay

frozen = replay.LAB / "frozen.json"
summary = replay.REPORT / "summary.json"
before = [sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (frozen, summary)]
with TemporaryDirectory(prefix="testpilot-loop-") as temp:
    fixture = Path(temp) / frozen.name
    changed = json.loads(frozen.read_bytes())
    changed["seeds"][0] += 1
    fixture.write_text(json.dumps(changed), encoding="utf-8")
    print("temporary seed changed:", changed["seeds"][0], flush=True)
    with patch.object(replay, "LAB", Path(temp)), patch.object(sys, "argv", ["verify_frozen"]):
        exit_code = replay.main()
    print("altered fixture exit:", exit_code, flush=True)
    if exit_code != 1:
        raise SystemExit("Expected CLI exit 1 for altered fixture")

with patch.object(sys, "argv", ["verify_frozen"]):
    print("original freeze retest:")
    original = replay.verify()
    print("original outcome:", original["outcome"])
    print("observed kills:", [arm["killed"] for arm in original["groups"].values()])
after = [sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (frozen, summary)]
print("inputs unchanged:", before == after, "sha256:", after)
if original["outcome"] != "passed" or before != after:
    raise SystemExit("Original replay or integrity check failed")
